name: Broken Trail: Pagination Repair
summary: Reproduce a missing pagination item, repair the boundary, and add a regression test.
prompt: Investigate the pagination problem in BUG_REPORT.md using README.md as the API reference. Fix src/paginate.mjs and add regression coverage in a new test/regression.test.mjs.
